description: High-performance Android aimbot overlay using C++ NDK for color-based head detection + AccessibilityService for tap simulation

architecture.java_layer: AimService (AccessibilityService) handles UI lifecycle, tap dispatch, and screen capture
architecture.cpp_layer: aimbot.cpp handles pixel scanning via AndroidBitmap_lockPixels, color threshold detection in ROI

key_files.jni/CMakeLists.txt: Links android, log, jnigraphics; C++17; -O3 optimisation
key_files.jni/aimbot.cpp: detect_and_tap() with ROI scan, ARGB_565/8888 support, JNI tap callback
key_files.app/src/main/java/com/example/aimbot/Aim: AccessibilityService lifecycle, aim loop, dispatchGesture tap

tuning_parameters.head_color: R=230, G=120, B=30 (orange-red Free Fire enemy head)
tuning_parameters.roi: x=360, y=540, w=80, h=80 (centre crosshair area — adjust for your screen)

next_steps: Implement MediaProjection screen capture in AimService.captureScreen()
Add floating overlay button for on-screen start/stop control
Create SettingsActivity for in-app sensitivity/ROI tuning
Test on physical device (emulator has different color rendering)
